arguments.summary: A coordinated investigation into a credential compromise revealed that the account of admin_jsmith was breached via malware on workstation WS-FIN-042. Initial detection stemmed from an SSH brute-force attempt, followed by confirmation of credential exposure on the dark web and anomalous Kerberos ticket requests from an unauthorized device. Analysis confirmed Cobalt Strike beaconing from the host, indicating active adversary presence and lateral movement attempts. Immediate containment actions were taken, including credential revocation and network isolation of the infected host.

SMB access from WS-FIN-042 to internal file server (10.0.5.50), suggesting lateral movement.
SSH brute-force attempt detected from 10.0.5.14 (WS-FIN-042) targeting bastion host; incident INC-2026-1203A created.
Credential leak detected: admin_jsmith credentials found on dark web; incident INC-2026-1203B created.
Anomalous Kerberos TGS request for admin_jsmith from workstation 10.0.6.99; incident INC-2026-1203C created.
SIEM correlation confirms link between incidents; all activity traced to WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42).
EDR confirms no active malicious processes on 10.0.6.99; likely spoofed source or compromised credential relay.
Admin phase concludes: credentials for admin_jsmith revoked, WS-FIN-042 isolated at firewall.

Containment was achieved by blocking all malicious IPs at the perimeter firewall.

author: SOC Team

    category: firewall
    product: generic
detection:
    tor_exit_ip:
        src_ip|cidr: 185.220.101.0/24
    scan_behavior:
        event_type: port_scan
    target_clustering:
        dst_ip: *
        same_dst_ip: "count(src_ip) by dst_ip > 5"
    timeframe: 60m
condition: tor_exit_ip and scan_behavior and target_clustering
level: high
